sentences.en: Bad news is preferable to an absence of information.
sentences.zh: 坏消息总比没有信息好。

sentences.en: Poverty with honesty is preferable to wealth obtained by unfair means.
sentences.zh: 贫穷但诚实比不义之财更好。

sentences.en: It is preferable that he gets there by tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 最好他能在明天之前到达那里。

senses.zh: 更好的, 更适合的, 更可取的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：prefer（更喜欢）+able（…的） →更喜欢就觉得更好→更好的
